verdict.rationale: Pulumi automations are code. Pulumi maintains its own GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps integrations, which covers versioning. Review is supported by `pulumi preview` (no changes applied) and by policy-violation comments on pull requests, and the Cloud REST API exposes stack history. Missing for 10: any documented rollback to a prior stack state or deployment, detail on how history and versioning work, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the review and rollback workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Connect Pulumi with GitHub, GitLab, and Azure DevOps using Pulumi-maintained version control integrations.
Show a preview of updates to a stack’s resources... No changes to the stack will actually take place.
Policy violations now appear in pull request comments and checks
The Pulumi Cloud REST API is used by the Pulumi CLI to query and interact with state information, history, stack tags, etc.
